SHITET APARTAMENT (2+1) Splendor Rezidence
Splendor Residence eshte nje projekt ambicioz i vendosur ne zonen e Porcelanit, vetem pak metra nga rruga kryesore. Hapësira e brendshme e kompleksit të banimit, krijon mikro hapësirë të gjelbra, gjysmë-fusha basketbolli, kënde lojërash për fëmijë, 2 lulishte të gjelbëruara dhe hapësira rekreative rreth tyre.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 114.55 m2 prej te cilave 93.26 m2 siperfaqe te brendshme neto
Organizohet ne sallon te madh, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkon.
Postparkim me cmim ekstra
Cmimi: 1450 euro/m2
description_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE (2+1) Splendor Residence Splendor Residence is an ambitious project located in the Porcelan area, just a few meters from the main road. The interior space of the residential complex creates micro green spaces, basketball half-courts, children's playgrounds, 2 green flower gardens and recreational spaces around them. The apartment has a total area of ​​114.55 m2, of which 93.26 m2 is net internal area. It is organized in a large living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Postparking with extra price Price: 1450 euro/m2
